work_items.title: Set up AWS serverless infrastructure
work_items.description: Set up AWS API Gateway, Lambda, Aurora Serverless, and S3 for the project.

work_items.title: Create Item and User tables
work_items.description: Implement the Item and User tables in Aurora Serverless based on the data model.

work_items.title: Implement authentication for web and mobile
work_items.description: Create session cookie authentication for the web and secure storage for the mobile app.

work_items.title: Build React Native app skeleton
work_items.description: Create the basic structure of the mobile app, including login and navigation.

work_items.title: Integrate native barcode scanning libraries
work_items.description: Implement iOS AVFoundation and Android ML Kit for barcode scanning in the mobile app.

work_items.title: Implement scan screen and damage form
work_items.description: Create UI components for barcode scanning and a form for damage reporting.

work_items.title: Backend API for barcode validation and pending write-off storage
work_items.description: Develop the backend API that validates scanned barcodes and stores pending write-offs.

work_items.title: S3 photo upload flow
work_items.description: Implement the functionality to upload damage photos to S3 and store the key in the write-off record.

work_items.title: Implement heuristic image analysis
work_items.description: Develop a heuristic analysis that calculates defect pixel percentage using the sharp library to establish severity tiers.

work_items.title: Build responsive web dashboard for supervisors
work_items.description: Create a web interface for supervisors to review pending write-offs with details and severity tiers.

work_items.title: Implement approval/reject endpoints
work_items.description: Create endpoints for supervisors to approve or reject write-offs, triggering inventory deductions upon approval.

work_items.title: Create InventoryTransaction table
work_items.description: Implement the InventoryTransaction table to log stock deductions.

work_items.title: Offline sync mechanism for mobile app
work_items.description: Implement a sync mechanism in the mobile app to handle offline write-off submissions.

work_items.title: Develop reporting page with Chart.js for web
work_items.description: Create a reporting component on the web dashboard displaying historical write-offs using Chart.js.

work_items.title: Add mobile app reports view
work_items.description: Implement a reporting view in the mobile app allowing users to filter and view historical write-offs.

work_items.title: Conduct user testing
work_items.description: Test the mobile app and web components with actual warehouse staff for usability under real conditions.

work_items.title: Final security review and configuration
work_items.description: Perform a final security review and configure Aurora Serverless for cost optimization.

work_items.title: Deploy to production and create documentation
work_items.description: Deploy the entire application to production, create user documentation, and train users on the system.
